notes: 2026-11-09 review pass by reviewer: Independent review, three rounds. Round 1 PASS with notes; the lead fixed 1, 2, 4, 5: the 00121 backfill skips an invalid quote deadline, the nine indexes build CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction (dropped first, so a failed run rebuilds them), a delivery Forwend can't build no longer turns the merchant's endpoint off, and the unbooked-money check no longer alerts on a read past the scan. Round 2 FAIL: both callers read at their node's head, so a real missed deposit could go unalerted; fixed by reading the signer's balance at min(finalized head, scan cursor), with a test that fails at the head. Checked across the merge: ProcessChain still picks every row its filter can pick, skipped no-op updates are safe, SettleWaitsSQL is right since settle pays exactly the amount, the per-payer return cap can't be bypassed with -to, M5 filters are necessary conditions of their CASEs, tracker concurrency is safe, 1Click budgets are spent only on real calls. Deferred: redundant invoices_profile index and the holding predicate (task F459), per-process budgets, tracker capacity, alertCrossChain full read (F459), historyComplete (F459).

A replacement over MaxSettleGas now ALERTs. Round 2 PASS. Checked: key rotation and wallet change still finish a sent settle; unmined's lowest-nonce wait skips no receipt for good; settlement_dropped writes can't fail on their own; DustExcess(decimals) at all three callers; arcTwins can't double count; migrations 00123-00126 run in order and dropping invoices_profile is covered by the two new profile indexes; webhook LATERAL claim keeps one request per endpoint; reserved idempotency prefixes don't touch internal creators; fee fields are always sent so the stricter web schema is safe; CROSSCHAIN_OFF leaves tracking working; the 401 alert flag is safe.
